CurrentMain.ExponentMetadataBitAdapter.scan_clears_restored : ∀
  (base : CurrentMain.DyadicAddExponentCleanup.BoundaryState) (rows : List CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.Pair),
  CurrentMain.ExponentMetadataBitAdapter.Matches base rows →
    base.savedExponent = base.target.fractionalBits →
      ∃ out,
        CurrentMain.ExponentMetadataBitAdapter.readTape
              (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.run (5 * rows.length + 4)
                  (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.initial rows)).tape =
            some out ∧
          List.map Prod.fst out = List.replicate rows.length false ∧ List.map Prod.snd out = List.map Prod.snd rows
CurrentMain.ExponentMetadataBitAdapter.scan_resources : ∀ (base : CurrentMain.DyadicAddExponentCleanup.BoundaryState)
  (rows : List CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.Pair),
  CurrentMain.ExponentMetadataBitAdapter.Matches base rows →
    CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.RunsToHalt (5 * rows.length + 4) (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.initial rows)
        (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.final (List.map CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.xorPair rows)) ∧
      CurrentMain.ExponentMetadataBitAdapter.observe base
            (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.run (5 * rows.length + 4) (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.initial rows)).tape =
          some
            (CurrentMain.DyadicAddExponentCleanup.step
              CurrentMain.DyadicAddExponentCleanup.MetadataInstruction.toggleExponent base) ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.cells
              (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.run k (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.initial rows)) =
            rows.length + 2

CurrentMain.FramedExponentMetadata.framed_toggle : ∀ (left right : List CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.Symbol)
  (base : CurrentMain.DyadicAddExponentCleanup.BoundaryState) (rows : List CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.Pair),
  CurrentMain.ExponentMetadataBitAdapter.Matches base rows →
    CurrentMain.FramedExponentMetadata.Observes left right base
      (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.run (5 * rows.length + 4)
          (CurrentMain.MarkedXorFraming.embed left right (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.initial rows))).tape
      (CurrentMain.DyadicAddExponentCleanup.step CurrentMain.DyadicAddExponentCleanup.MetadataInstruction.toggleExponent
        base)
CurrentMain.FramedExponentMetadata.framed_clear : ∀ (left right : List CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.Symbol)
  (base : CurrentMain.DyadicAddExponentCleanup.BoundaryState) (rows : List CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.Pair),
  CurrentMain.ExponentMetadataBitAdapter.Matches base rows →
    base.savedExponent = base.target.fractionalBits →
      ∃ out,
        CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.run (5 * rows.length + 4)
              (CurrentMain.MarkedXorFraming.embed left right (CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.initial rows)) =
            { tape := { left := left, right := CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.marked out ++ right }, scratch := false,
              phase := CurrentMain.MarkedBitXorScan.Phase.halt } ∧
          List.map Prod.fst out = List.replicate rows.length false ∧ List.map Prod.snd out = List.map Prod.snd rows

acceptance_note: Exact source SHA-256 values bind later successful kernel acceptance. Historical uncompiled-candidate comments are preserved verbatim; this source-bound summary records the completed acceptance. Existing evidence was read without a new compiler run.
limits: Reference restoreCell uses unbounded integer subtraction, exact division and exponent arithmetic. It is proved on an actual aligned-ADD forward image, not arbitrary unrelated inputs.
Cleanup preserves the supplied post-ADD accumulator. It does not recover the accumulator that preceded the reference ADD tape or establish arbitrary dirty-scratch restoration.
The marked XOR implements only the two represented exponent fields under explicit Matches. Other BoundaryState fields are semantic parameters, not newly implemented physical storage.

The first-halt and tape-cell bounds price the accepted finite-symbol XOR model with a supplied marked paired input and false scan scratch. Encoding, width selection, pairing, marker installation, allocation and locating a segment remain caller work.
The strict observer is applied to an explicit local segment witness; no ambient parser or boundary search is implemented. The left spectator list is in stored reverse order.
Selected physical allocation, complete integer arithmetic execution, global precision, uniform recursive bit cost and the full multiplication theorem remain open.
